Work version
Orchestral ballet; this 1960 performance uses the separately published 1943 revision of the final Sacrificial Dance. Documented

Not a literal restoration of the 1913 performance. Part I stage notes use shared scoring features of the later corrected Boosey/Dover score; a detailed Part II stage map is withheld because the matching 1943 finale score was not inspected.

Composition rights
The composition is not established public domain in the EU. Early published score material has different territorial status; the 1943 finale requires its own assessment. Documented

The sound-recording selection rule is not a blanket clearance of every edition or underlying composition right.

[7] [4]
Recording rights
EU territorial phonogram-term basis: first lawful publication in 1961, before 1963. US recording status not established. Documented

Programme rule 3. The first publication may be a US issue; the EU term is not restarted by a later EU reissue. No Creative Commons licence is claimed for this transfer.
